subject: The one thing 90% of users skip (big mistake)
preview_text: I discovered something about how the top 10% of students use this app. It changes everything.
body_paragraphs: Okay, confession time. When I first built Thesis Generator, I thought the main thesis builder was the star. But after watching 50,000+ students use it, I realized I was wrong. The real magic happens somewhere else, and almost everyone misses it.

The students who go from B+ to A- aren't just generating a thesis and calling it a day. They're doing one extra thing that takes 2 minutes and completely transforms their paper. It's the difference between a good draft and a submission-ready paper that professors actually love. Most people skip it because they're in deadline panic mode and just want the thesis statement.

It's the 'Humanize AI' button. It's not just for bypassing Turnitin. It restructures your entire paper's flow, adds academic nuance, and makes your arguments sound like you spent weeks, not minutes. It's the secret weapon the top performers use right before they export their polished PDF.

Open the app right now, paste any AI-generated section you have, and hit 'Humanize AI'. See the difference in 30 seconds. P.S. The students who use this feature report the biggest grade jumps because it solves the 'this sounds like ChatGPT' panic instantly.
cta_text: Open Thesis Generator & Try Humanize AI
